protocol: Decoupled cRT-style experiment: freeze the deployed ONNX image model, use its logits as a compact representation, and retrain only a class-balanced logistic head on each grouped SCIN split.
selection_protocol: C is selected on a nested grouped calibration split carved from training data only; the grouped evaluation fold is used once for final reporting.
interpretation: Nested C-selection confirms that a class-balanced decoupled logistic head can move the fixed deployed encoder toward a tail-sensitive operating point: accuracy falls versus the conservative deployed prior, while macro recall rises. Because the encoder itself may have seen SCIN-derived cases during original fine-tuning, this is an operating-point experiment, not a clean model benchmark.
validity_note: C-selection is now nested inside each grouped training fold, so the evaluation fold is not used for head hyperparameter selection. However, the frozen logits come from the previously SCIN-trained deployed ONNX encoder, so this remains a fixed-encoder head experiment rather than a clean representation benchmark.

comparison_scope.valid_within_artifact: Compare nested_decoupled_balanced_logit_head against deployed_conservative_prior as operating points on the same fixed deployed encoder.
comparison_scope.not_valid_as_clean_model_baseline: Do not compare this directly against Derm Foundation or fair fold-retrained MobileNet as if the frozen encoder had not seen SCIN-derived training cases.
